title: Volume-confirmed twenty-hour high break that must hold for two bars

source.title: Livermore Pivotal Point (LuxAlgo library), via lab hypothesis H-046

rule_summary: Hourly chart, fills at the next open. Pivot is the highest high of the previous 20 bars. Buy at a bar close that is 0.2% above the pivot, when its volume is at least double the mean volume of the previous 4 bars and the close is above the 40-bar mean, nothing open, one bar after the last sale. If either of the next two bars closes under the pivot, sell at the following open. After those two bars, sell when a close falls under the lowest low of the previous 4 bars. Stop two percent under the fill. Buys only for bars opening 00:00 to 16:00 UTC; flat by the 23:00 UTC open or after twelve hours.
mechanism: Real demand makes a volume-backed break hold immediately; a quick fall back under the pivot reveals a failed break, so cutting it early limits losses. Parent windows (240, 48, 480 bars) divided by twelve. Expected gross move about 0.9% on winners; a design estimate.
